title: Mahabharata Game
author: needle706
selftext:
**Want to live a life inside the Mahabharata - the great indian mythological epic?**

This RPG game you create your own character and live a whole life alongside the Pandavas and Kauravas. You train under their teachers, choose a path (archer, mace, charioteer, healer, spy and more), make friends, swear vows, pick a side, and try to survive the war. 

The epic stays as it is; your choices shape your story inside it.

It has real-time fights with parries and shields, war days where you give orders and then fight a real-time clash, and tests like archery, stealth and escaping the burning house of lac. There are painted scenes, shadow-puppet figures, a dozen-plus endings, and English and Hindi.

It's free and runs in the browser on a phone or laptop, about an hour a life: \[[LINK\]](https://apurv706.github.io/Mahabharata-game/game/)

I'd love to know how far into the war you got, whether the fights felt fair, and any bugs (with your device).  
(Art, animation, music and much of the text were made with AI tools, directed and edited by me.)

The game was built using claude projects on my phone during transit to and from work. Treated it like an actual developer partner

*Describe the feeling, let the AI research and draft, lock it in a doc, ship a playable link fast, then iterate by playing*
